messages:
tess: Heads-up: customers seeing quota churn this morning. Console shows project bucket dipping but logs indicate caller_id=sa:exporter-3. Might be the new router rule `route:caller-first` we flipped to canary.
omar: I noticed that too. Console only surfaces `project_id` so it's confusing. Can you paste the sample logs?
tess: sample:
```
ts=2024-05-10T07:41:22Z project=proj-900 caller_id=sa:exporter-3 route=route:caller-first tokens=48 status=200
```
natalie: Ok. Current enforcement is still project-first, but the router emits caller_id now. We never used caller_id in quota decisions.
hugo: Quick plan: emit duplicate telemetry rows with both attribution keys: `attr.project` and `attr.caller`. Quota engine can then be switched to read `attr.caller` when a tenant opt-in flag is on. We should gate by tenant to avoid surprise billing.
omar: I like tenant gating. Also add a small UI hint on the Quotas page: "Attribution: PROJECT (preview Caller enforcement)" with a preview link showing delta. That will reduce support noise.
tess: Ops ask: can we pause the canary until we have a reconciliation snapshot?
ops-bot: Action: route-service:canary(12%) paused by tess at 07:45 UTC.
hugo: I'll add the telemetry dup emit (ETA 6h) and a one-shot job that computes per-project projected differences for the last 48h.
natalie: I'll add a feature flag `tenant_attr_caller` and tests: when flag=true and `attr.caller` present, quota should debit caller bucket; otherwise project. Add an auto-safety to disable for a tenant if delta>4%.
omar: Who owns console changes? I can mock the inline hint and preview modal, link to the recon CSV.
tess: Owners: hugo (telemetry + recon job), natalie (quota flag + tests + safety auto-disable), omar (console mock + docs). ETA: recon + PRs in 8 hours.
hugo: I'll post the CSV here when done. Will also include a trivial SQL used for recon so support can reproduce.
tess: Thanks all. Leaving thread open for the CSV. :eyes:
